text:
marta: Quick coordination for Liu Wei (remote, starts Mon). Two immediate items: BG still pending identity docs and we need I-9 verification. Can we get options documented so day 1 isn't blocked?

kevin: Options: (1) Liu comes to SF Mon for in-person I-9, (2) use vendor remote I-9 (video + consent), (3) candidate visits an authorized agent near Oakland. Which does Liu prefer?

liu: I prefer remote verify Tue morning if possible. I can do live video and show original ID.

bg-vendor: Vendor note: ID image mismatched (name formatting). Requested clearer passport scan + headshot selfie. Estimated 12-24 hrs after re-upload.

marta: I'll message Liu the re-upload checklist (exact legal name, full-page passport scan, good lighting). If vendor doesn't clear by Mon 08:00, fallback = remote vendor I-9 Tue 09:30.

hr-bot: Reminder: need signed offer acceptance, W-4, direct deposit, and benefits election within first 30 days. Send links now so Liu can prefill.

kevin: Can IT provision provisional access if BG unresolved? We can do escorted-only profile with limited VPN and no prod access, expires in 7 days. Manager approval required.

it-ops: Yes. Create temp account 'liu-onboard' expires in 7 days. Needs manager sign-off (kevin). We'll hold until BG status at Mon 08:00.

courier-bot: If physical packet preferred, we can hold crate at UPS store for pickup or ship to address. Include benefits packet + W-4 copy. Cost est $14. Delivery Mon noon if shipped overnight Sun.

marta: Liu wants digital first. Still include paper packet only if requested. Also please create a Zoom calendar invite for Day 1 orientation 10:00-11:30 Mon.

notary-agent: Vendor remote I-9 slot available Tue 09:30 PST. Cost $35. Needs signed consent link and original ID on camera.

liu: Consent sent and re-uploading passport now (doing tonight). Also prefer digital orientation invite — thanks.

bg-vendor: Candidate re-upload received at 22:14 PST. Under review, ETA 6-10 hrs.

kevin: Manager approval granted for provisional profile if needed. IT please standby to toggle on Mon 07:30 if BG not cleared.

it-ops: Ticket INF-7733 created. Temp profile ready, will activate on request.

marta: Final plan: re-upload in progress; if cleared before Mon 08:00 proceed normally; if not, activate temp profile Mon 07:30 and schedule remote vendor I-9 Tue 09:30. Liu, bring passport + SSN card for the remote slot. I'll post update here once vendor clears. :white_check_mark:
